from.place: the restriction-compatibility reduction through the support criterion for the right adjoint

title: Support criterion for restriction of a right adjoint to a quasi-compact open
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let a be the right adjoint to Rf_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let V\subset Y be a quasi-compact open with inverse image U\subset X. For the canonical restriction map j_U^*a(K)\to a_V(Lj^*K) constructed from the base-change transformation for the open square, the following hold: (i) for every Q in D_QCoh^+(Y) supported on Y\setminus V, a(Q) is supported on X\setminus U if and only if the map is an isomorphism for every K in D_QCoh^+(Y); (ii) if a commutes with all set-indexed direct sums, then these equivalent conditions are also equivalent to a(Q) being supported on X\setminus U for every Q in D_QCoh(Y), and to the map being an isomorphism for every K in D_QCoh(Y).
